subject: Re: New job opportunites at Flowmingo for Quynh Anh
latest_message:
Hi Patricia,

Thank you very much for reaching out and sharing these opportunities with
me.

I’m writing to let you know that I have recently accepted another offer, so
I won’t be pursuing new roles at this time. I truly appreciate you keeping
my profile in mind and hope we might have the chance to collaborate in the
future.

Wishing you and Flowmingo all the best in finding the right candidates.

Best regards,

*Quynh Anh*
